ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious ScreenSave Change by Reg.exe
ruleDefinitions.description:
Adversaries may establish persistence by executing malicious content triggered by user inactivity.
Screensavers are programs that execute after a configurable time of user inactivity and consist of Portable Executable (PE) files with a .scr file extension

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*HKEY\\_CURRENT\\_USER\\\\Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*HKCU\\\\Control\\ Panel\\\\Desktop.*"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ ScreenSaveActive.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ REG\\_SZ.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ 1.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ ScreenSaveTimeout.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ REG\\_SZ.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ ScreenSaverIsSecure.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ REG\\_SZ.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ 0.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/v\\ SCRNSAVE\\\.EXE.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/t\\ REG\\_SZ.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scr.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f.*")))
